function.name: delete_app_plan_objects
function.description: Delete exact current App Plan objects by type and ID. No cascade or implicit reference repair: first save affected objects to remove references. Same-batch deletions are checked against the remaining graph; any dangling reference rejects the entire batch. Deleting a Service also removes its nested Operations. Does not delete the root/settings or runtime resources. Empty targets is a no-op.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
